_comment: Ground cover for scenes/levels/vale.tscn, read by Grass.rebuild(). Lattice radius/cell size live on the Grass node; this file holds the wind, the zones file and the layers. zones is the GrassZones data (data/grass/zones_vale.json): where grass is dense or sparse, tall or short, and what colour; a layer with zone 'grass' scales its density by the zone's, 'tall' and 'flowers' by those 0..1 weights, and zoned blades take the zone's palette and height, so root_color/tip_color here are the fallback when no zone applies. density is instances per square metre on ideal ground in a 1.0x zone (before Grass.density_at and the multipliers below); a 'grass' layer's candidate pool is sized for the densest zone, so max_per_cell must hold density x the zones' max density x cell area. scale is uniform, height the blade height in metres (clump and flower only); dry_tint/dry_amount drift each blade part way toward a straw colour; patch_min/patch_frequency is low-frequency noise that thins the field in patches (1.0 = none); hollow boosts density in cells below their surroundings (negative on knolls); cluster thickens within radius of the Forest's trees and falls to `outside` beyond radius+falloff; fade is [start, end] metres over which the shader sinks the piece into the ground; far_fraction is the share still drawn at the lattice edge; align tilts toward the ground normal (0 upright, 1 flat); colors are the wildflower head colours, one per instance. Palettes are UNVERIFIED by eye (W8-G): the owner asked for beautiful, dark-fantasy grass, not the old ashen no-green brief; headless cannot judge it.
